questions.question: A boat takes 11 hours to travel a distance upstream and takes 5 hours to travel the same distance downstream. If the speed of the boat in still water is 2(2)/(9) m/sec, then the speed of the stream (in km/h) is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

upstream time 11 h and downstream time 5 hrs.

The speed = 2(2)/(9) m/sec

**Calculation:**

2(2)/(9) m/sec = 20/9 × 18/5

⇒ 8 km/h

Let the speed of the stream is u km/h

As per the question,

⇒ 11 ( 8 - u) = 5 (8 + u)

⇒ 16 u = 48 

⇒ u = 3 km/h

 **∴ The correct option is 2**

questions.question: Sukhen purchased some perishable items for sale but 15% of those items could not be sold and went bad. However, Sukhen managed to sell the rest of the items at a price that helped him earn an overall profit of 19%. At what percentage above the cost price of each item did Sukhen sell each of the items that did NOT go bad?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

15 % was wasted and Profit = 19%.

**Calculation:**

Let the total number of items be 100 and the cost price of each item be Rs 100

Total cost price is 100 × 100 = Rs 10000

The total Selling price is , 10000 × 119 /100 = Rs11900

The total number of good items is 85

The selling price of good items is 11900 / 85 = Rs 140

So the above percentage is 140 - 100 = 40%

**∴ The correct option is 1**

questions.question: What is the least value of x for which the number 712x816 is divisible by 12?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Divisibility by 12 ⇒ Number must be divisible by 3 and 4.

For 4: Last two digits 16 are divisible by 4 (True).

For 3: Sum of digits (7+1+2+x+8+1+6) = 25 + x must be divisible by 3.

Nearest multiples of 3 > 25 are 27, 30, 33.

For least value: 25 + x = 27 ⇒ x = 2.

**∴ The correct answer is 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Number = 712x816, Divisor = 12

**Formula Used:** Divisibility rule of 12 (divisible by 3 and 4).

 
 7 1 2 x 8 1 6
 

 Sum of digits (Rule of 3)
 
 Check: 16 ÷ 4

Check Divisibility by 4:

⇒ Last two digits of 712x816 = 16

⇒ 16 ÷ 4 = 4 (Remainder = 0)

⇒ The number is divisible by 4 for any value of x.

Check Divisibility by 3:

⇒ Sum of digits = 7 + 1 + 2 + x + 8 + 1 + 6

⇒ Sum = 25 + x

⇒ For the number to be divisible by 3, (25 + x) must be a multiple of 3.

⇒ Possible values for (25 + x) are 27, 30, 33, ...

⇒ For least value of x: 25 + x = 27

⇒ x = 27 − 25

⇒ x = 2

**∴ The correct answer is 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Divisibility by 3

A number is divisible by 3 if the sum of its digits is divisible by 3.

Divisibility by 4

A number is divisible by 4 if the last two digits of the number are divisible by 4 or are 00.

Divisibility by 11

A number is divisible by 11 if the difference between the sum of digits at odd positions and the sum of digits at even positions is 0 or a multiple of 11.

Composite Divisibility

If a number is divisible by two co-prime numbers a and b, it is also divisible by their product (a × b). Example: 12 = 3 × 4.</p

questions.question: A can do a piece of work in 24 days and B can do the same work in 30 days. If they work on it together for 8 days, then the fraction of the work that is left is:
questions.solution:

They work on it together for 8 days

Concept used:

Efficiency = (Total work / Total time taken)

Efficiency = work done in a single day 

Calculation:

Let total work is 120 units ( Lcm of 24 and30 )

The efficiency of R is

⇒ 120 / 24 = 5 unit

Again, the Efficiency of S is,

Total Efficiency,

⇒ 5 + 4 = 9 unit

Total work done in 8 days,

⇒ 9 × 8 = 72 units

Total done 72 / 120 = 3/5 part

Part left (1 - 3/5) = 2/5 part 

∴ The correct option is 2

questions.question: What will be the perimeter (in cm) of the sector of a circle of radius 4.9 cm having central angle 144° (use pi = (22)/(7))
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The perimeter of a sector consists of its arc length and two radii.

Arc length = (θ ÷ 360°) × 2πr = (144 ÷ 360) × 2 × (22 ÷ 7) × 4.9 = 12.32 cm

Perimeter = Arc length + 2 × r

⇒ Perimeter = 12.32 + 2 × 4.9 = 12.32 + 9.8 = 22.12 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 22.12 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/68fce97c77a4607cf5e2bcd8fe45fec866bf5454303df424bb5fb107004b994b.png] 

**Given:**

Radius of the sector (r) = 4.9 cm

Central angle (θ) = 144°

**Formula Used:**

Perimeter of a sector = Arc length (l) + 2r

Arc length (l) = (θ ÷ 360°) × 2πr

**Calculations:**

⇒ Arc length (l) = (144° ÷ 360°) × 2 × (22 ÷ 7) × 4.9

⇒ l = (2 ÷ 5) × 2 × 22 × 0.7

⇒ l = 0.4 × 30.8 = 12.32 cm

⇒ Perimeter of sector = l + 2r

⇒ Perimeter = 12.32 + 2 × 4.9

⇒ Perimeter = 12.32 + 9.8 = 22.12 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 22.12 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Area of Sector

Area = (θ ÷ 360°) × πr². It represents the region enclosed by two radii and the corresponding arc.

Length of Arc

Arc length (l) = (θ ÷ 360°) × 2πr. It calculates the boundary length of the curved part of a sector.

Area of a Segment

The area enclosed between a chord and its corresponding arc. Area = Area of Sector − Area of Triangle.
</p
